data: Just can't help sending you another personalized word puzzle.
It is my pleasure to collect the seals and do the puzzles just to prove what a devout smoker I am.
I am not sure if you will send me another order form for the 70 pack seals for one carton of local Ultra lights 100's, or if I have to call you.
I will call you for an order form.
I would like to know why so many supermarkets don't sell them.
The only supermarket where I live that sells them is Pathmark!
King Kullen, Shop Rite & Grand Union supermarkets don't sell them,
most gas stations do but they don't accept coupons.
So I go to Pathmark or K-Mart to buy my cigarettes.
Don't know why I write you all
